subject: How to make work a ConditionalPanel with several numeric options?

messages.author: 3c5c46f91a95889d
messages.subject: How to make work a ConditionalPanel with several numeric options?
parts:
Hi,
I'd like the user to choose a number (numtipus, 1 or 2) and depending on that number to show different input options. I'm using ConditionalPanel, I tried it but I wasn't able to implement it properly. When it is executed in numtipus=1 everything is fine, but when it runs in numtipus=2 I cannot change reactively the variables already defined in numtipus=1: nombre1, consumvell1 and tipusnou1. Why?


Here the ui.R
....
selectInput("numtipus", "Nombre de tipus:", choices=c(1,2)),

conditionalPanel(
condition = "input.numtipus == 1",
h4("D.Substitució 1"),
numericInput("nombre1", "Nombre unitats:", 0),
numericInput("consumvell1", "Consum actual:", 100),
selectInput("tipusnou1", "Tipus nova il·luminació:",
choices = levels(dades[,1]))
),

conditionalPanel(
condition = "input.numtipus == 2",
h4("D.Substitució 1"),
numericInput("nombre1", "Nombre unitats:", 0),
numericInput("consumvell1", "Consum actual:", 100),
selectInput("tipusnou1", "Tipus nova il·luminació:",
choices = levels(dades[,1])),

h4("E.Substitució 2"),
numericInput("nombre2", "Nombre unitats:", 0), 
numericInput("consumvell2", "Consum actual:", 100), 
selectInput("tipusnou2", "Tipus nova il·luminació:", 
choices = levels(dades[,1])) 
),
....

Here the server.R

.....
data1<- reactive(function() {

nombre1<-input$nombre1 
consumvell1<-input$consumvell1
tipusnou1<-which(dades[,1]==input$tipusnou1)

nombre2<-input$nombre2
consumvell2<-input$consumvell2 
tipusnou2<-which(dades[,1]==input$tipusnou2)

ara1<-c(nombre1,consumvell1,tipusnou1)
ara2<-c(nombre2,consumvell2,tipusnou2)
rbind(ara1,ara2)

})
....


Any idea what am I doing wrongly? I guess I'm missing something about the ConditionalPanel but I cannot see what.

All comments appreciated,

Campa,

Bon Sant Jordi.
